newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport cargo traffic up 6.3pct in Jan '97.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport cargo traffic up 6.3pct in Jan '97.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport in January 1997 was up 6.3 percent on the same month last year at 33,808 tonnes, airport authority figures show.
Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines increased by 4.8 percent on January 1996 to 18,845 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up by 1.1 percent to 5,400 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight grew by 12.7 percent on January 1996 to 9,563 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Postal traffic totalled 1,595 tonnes, up 20.7 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
